description: Fork of exp752 (exp750 recipe at 16K: bf16 LUT storage + fp32 master Lion + fp32 head + clip(1.0)). Single change: forward_mode hard -> hybrid_smooth (top-2 soft blended forward via _FastMHLutHybridSmooth). Keeps backward_mode=dense_K. Tests the untested hybrid_smooth + dense_K combination on top of today's bf16-storage + master + clip stack. Reference: exp724 = 1.1936 @ 16K (TinyMHLut hybrid_smooth, same arch, no bf16/master/clip wins). If hybrid_smooth + dense_K beats hard + dense_K (exp752 projected ~1.215), we have a new SOTA recipe combining best of both worlds. Caveat: soft eval, will need hard-eval at deployment time (expect +~0.07 gap per exp730).
